items.text: One puzzle a day, and everybody on the planet gets the identical grid — and the identical upgrades on offer. You get one run at it.
Chain letters that touch, beat the target, take an upgrade, go again. A good run is about ten minutes.
Then it hands you your best word of the day, and a leaderboard for you and your friends.
No account, no download. It is a webpage. Letterbind.
